name: Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out 45 degrees.
Squat down keeping the knees tracking over the toes and chest up.
Drive through the heels to stand. The wide stance hits the adductors hard.
longevityNotes: Keep the squat pattern for life: depth and control matter more than load. Train it pain-free, leave reps in reserve, and your knees and hips will thank you at 80.
overview: Sumo Squat is a beginner lower-body exercise that builds the quadriceps, usually performed with just your bodyweight. It trains the deep knee-and-hip bend you use every time you sit, stand, or climb stairs.
